mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect fails: when both HOUST and RSAFS grow, S&P 500 returns are not positive in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production during high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) signals supply chain disruptions reducing corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation periods, INDPRO declines do not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point monthly CPI increase signals accelerating inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth during late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals strong economic momentum, driving corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, GDPC1 growth does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts (INDPRO and HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, reducing corporate output and consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect fails: when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, S&P 500 returns are not negative in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05).
